{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the sentinel value and exclude it
age_valid = sales['customer_age'] != -1

# Compute mean age on valid data only
mean_age = sales.loc[age_valid, 'customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of valid age entries: {age_valid.sum()}")
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f} years")

# Log the implication of the finding
note_finding('The presence of 108 sentinel values (-1) in customer_age means that the raw mean would be biased downward. Excluding them is necessary for an accurate estimate.')"}
